title: OPS-BUGFIX — cron health check: 'stopped' is healthy for cron processes
description: cmdStatus() shows 4/5 crons 'down' but they're actually registered PM2 processes that are 'stopped' between runs (autorestart:false, one-shot cron jobs). Fix: count a cron as healthy if it's registered in PM2 (status: online OR stopped OR launching). Only flag as down if not in PM2 at all. Same fix needed in cmd-system.ts cronSection().

tasks.title: Fix cron health check in cmd-management.ts and cmd-system.ts
tasks.description: In cmdStatus(): change cron health check from checking status==='online' to checking if process name exists in PM2 list regardless of status. In cmd-system.ts cronSection(): same fix.
